caption:
what kind of dark circles do I have?

Usually more than one kind — and they don't respond to the same things.

Brown that runs in families is often pigment. Blue or purple is often vessels showing through thin skin. Some darkness is only shadow, cast by the shape of the area. Many people have more than one.

The mirror check: gently stretch the skin under the eye. If it lightens, shape is part of it. If it turns bluer, vessels are. If nothing changes, it is likely pigment. Then tilt your chin toward a window — darkness that fades in direct light is shadow.

This is a hint, not a diagnosis. Darkness that is new, alongside tiredness, is worth mentioning to a doctor.

Ranu H et al. Dermatol Surg 2011 · Sheth PB et al. Indian J Dermatol 2014
General education only.
